question.text:
A rectangle has its base on the $x$-axis, and its upper two vertices lie on the curve $y=27-x^2$. What is the maximum possible area of the rectangle?

  1. $81$
     
  2. $108$
     
  3. $162$
     
  4. $216$
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:
The intervals for which the function $G(x)=\frac{x^2}{2}-2x-6\ln(x^2+1)+14\tan^{-1}x$ is increasing are

  1. $x<-3,\ 1<x<4$
     
  2. $-3<x<1,\ x>4$
     
  3. $x<-3,\ x>4$
     
  4. $-3<x<4$
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:
Let $f$ be continuous on the closed interval $[0,7]$. Some values of $f$ are shown below.

\[
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 & 5 & 6 & 7 \\
\hline
f(x) & 7 & k & -2 & 6 & 0 & k & 8 & -3\\
\hline
\end{array}
\]

The equation $(f(x)-2)^2=9$ must have at least ten distinct solutions in the interval $(0,7)$ if $k=$

  1. $-4$
     
  2. $-1$
     
  3. $0$
     
  4. $5$
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:
A closed circular cylinder has volume $54\pi$. What is the minimum possible surface area of the cylinder?

  1. $54\pi$
     
  2. $72\pi$
     
  3. $81\pi$
     
  4. $108\pi$
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:

  1. $x<-2,\ 1<x<3$
     
  2. $-2<x<1,\ x>3$
     
  3. $x<1,\ x>3$
     
  4. $-2<x<3$
